name: Topological Invariants Under Continuation Law
purpose: Define candidate invariants preserved under bounded recursive continuation transformations.

candidate_law_statement.informal: Even while continuation structures mutate, fracture, merge, decay, or reorganize, some bounded relational properties may remain invariant within declared admissibility and reconstruction tolerances.

formal.invariant_candidate_family: Inv_A(U) := { I_k : I_k remains stable under admissibility-compatible continuation transformations over region U }
formal.persistence_invariant_candidate: I_p := persistence continuity above threshold under bounded drift
formal.accessibility_invariant_candidate: I_a := preserved reachability-equivalence class under topology mutation
formal.reinforcement_invariant_candidate: I_r := retained reinforcement-overlap above declared tolerance
formal.reconstruction_invariant_candidate: I_xi := preserved reconstruction-equivalence relation under bounded compression
formal.failure_condition: Invariant failure occurs when topology transition, perturbation, decay, or budget saturation breaks declared preservation tolerance.
formal.non_global_clause: Invariants are local, conditional, and admissibility-bounded; no universal invariant or global conservation law is claimed.
